$comment: The BitCent (B¢) frozen issuance record. scripts/deploy-qct-bitcoin.js loads THIS file -- it never hardcodes tokenomics. A Rune's name, divisibility, cap and premine are immutable at etch, so this record is the single place those values may be set, and 'ratified: false' on any field is a hard refusal to broadcast, not a warning. See codexes/packs/agentiq/updates/2026-07-30_bitcent-frozen-issuance-record.md for the full history and codexes/packs/agentiq/updates/2026-07-29_qriptocent-supply-constitution.md for the ten-item freeze list this implements.

divisibility.note: Operator ruling 2026-07-30: 2, not 18 -- B¢ is already a cent-denominated unit; 0.01 B¢ = one ten-thousandth of the reference dollar. Supersedes the 8 previously coded here and the 18 raised for discussion.

maxSupply.note: Ratified 2026-07-29, qriptocent-supply-constitution.md. Independent of Base Q¢'s own 1,000,000,000 -- per-denomination, not per-chain.

premine.note: Ratified 2026-07-29. Supersedes the 400,000,000 figure still coded in the now-deleted deploy-qct-runes.*.

mintTerms.note: OPEN. Prior code (deploy-qct-bitcoin.js, pre-consolidation) carried amountPerMint=1000/cap=900000000 as an unratified placeholder -- never confirmed as a ruling, only as code. Do not treat as authoritative. Must be set here, explicitly, before mainnet.

allocationSchedule.note: OPEN -- proposed, not ratified (operator, 2026-07-30). Proposal on record: 35% settlement liquidity/market-making (35,000,000), 25% service-economy reserve (25,000,000), 15% ecosystem incentives/participation (15,000,000), 10% operational settlement reserve (10,000,000), 10% treasury/contingency (10,000,000), 5% future governed distribution (5,000,000) -- sums to the 100,000,000 premine. This redistributes the premine among purposes; it does not reopen the premine amount itself.

premineCustodian.note: OPEN -- policy ratified, wallet not yet provisioned (operator, 2026-07-30). Custodian is a dedicated 'Aigent Z BitCent Treasury' -- Aigent Z as operational treasury custodian (not MoneyPenny, which orchestrates Financial Services Runtime but must not control the issuance reserve; not Aigent Nakamoto, which oversees Bitcoin issuance integrity/governance with approval-or-veto authority over issuance-sensitive acts). Required before this field ratifies: a real wallet address, threshold/multisig control (never a single-key wallet), spending-limit and approval policy, recovery/rotation procedure, DVN receipts for every consequential movement, independent reconciliation against the B¢ ledger.

relationshipToBaseQc.value: independent native ledgers; cent-for-cent protocol settlement via DVN-mediated debit-and-credit; no wrapped-token bridging; no lock-and-mint

independenceDeclaration.value: BitCent (B¢) and Base Q¢ are separate canonical denominations of one stable-value class (QriptoCENT), each with its own native ledger and independently governed maximum supply. Neither is a wrapped or bridged representation of the other.
